verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents its own background automation: the bot can auto-join calendar meetings to record, transcribe and summarize without intervention, and a Rules Engine offers admin automation workflows. However, the Rules Engine is scoped to meeting access and privacy, and broader user-defined automations rely on webhooks and Zapier, which are building blocks and third-party tools rather than a native automation builder. Missing for 10: a general-purpose native automation/workflow builder with user-defined triggers and actions, documentation of how Rules Engine rules are configured and what they can do, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
